contract.userJob: See what changed, whether a threshold was crossed, and what needs attention next.

layout.wide: Prioritize change and alerts before supporting metrics and history.
layout.compact: Stack alerts, change, status, and next actions before optional history.

contract.fallback: Preserve status, change, thresholds, alerts, actions, time context, and sources.

gaps: No dedicated status, progression, alert, and action hierarchy exists.
The current generic metric treatment risks looking like an arbitrary dashboard.
quality.nextAction: Design a restrained monitoring view that prioritizes change, alert thresholds, and next actions.
